traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 12, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. _Failure:_ 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.text: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. _Failure:_ The target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.
